structural_ceiling.verdict: BUY_CE (>=40) is STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE in score_signal.py even with every implemented input present (max +39). With harness data (+/-34) the gap is 6-21 points.

pcr_positive_cap.rule: score_signal.py:21 — only positive side capped (min(s,4)); negative -8 uncapped
pcr_positive_cap.effect_on_positives: +8 tier reduced to +4 on these sessions

oi_tie_rule.rule: score_signal.py:27 — s += 8 if d_pe > d_ce else -8 (ties and d_pe<d_ce both -> -8)

pcr_bucket_tiers.boundary_note: pcr in (0.8,1.0] -> -3 and pcr exactly 1.0 -> -3 (neutral PCR lands on negative bucket)

skew_triggers.note: neutral band is [-1,+2]: +3 fires with 1 vol-pt move, -3 needs 2 vol-pt move (asymmetric toward POSITIVE)
